    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">每天一个安卓测试开发小知识之 （五）---常用的adb shell命令第三期 pm命令第二期</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="每天一个安卓测试开发小知识之-五---常用的adb-shell命令第三期-pm命令第二期">每天一个安卓测试开发小知识之 （五）---常用的adb shell命令第三期 pm命令第二期</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>上一期我们简单介绍了pm 命令的安装卸载，以及查看已安装的app的功能。本期继续介绍</p>
<ul>
<li>查看已安装的第三方包</li>
<li>获取app的启动activity</li>
<li>清除应用数据</li>
<li>启用被禁用或者禁用 应用/组件</li>
<li>隐藏/展示应用icon</li>
<li>授予应用权限，以及查看app声明的权限</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="1-查看已安装的第三方包">1. 查看已安装的第三方包</h2>
<p>包分为设备制造商应用（第一方应用）和第三方应用，例如</p>
<ul>
<li>手机里的设置、电话、通讯录就属于第一方应用</li>
<li>微信、qq、支付宝 就属于第三方应用</li>
</ul>
<p><code>adb shell pm list packages</code> 会列出已安装的包名，如何获取到已安装的第三方的包，查看pm命令的帮助可以看到</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">  list packages [-f] [-d] [-e] [-s] [-q] [-3] [-i] [-l] [-u] [-U] 
      [--show-versioncode] [--apex-only] [--factory-only]
      [--uid UID] [--user USER_ID] [FILTER]
    Prints all packages; optionally only those whose name contains
    the text in FILTER.  Options are:
      -f: see their associated file
      -a: all known packages (but excluding APEXes)
      -d: filter to only show disabled packages
      -e: filter to only show enabled packages
      -s: filter to only show system packages
      -3: filter to only show third party packages
      -i: see the installer for the packages
      -l: ignored (used for compatibility with older releases)
      -U: also show the package UID
      -u: also include uninstalled packages
      --show-versioncode: also show the version code
      --apex-only: only show APEX packages
      --factory-only: only show system packages excluding updates
      --uid UID: filter to only show packages with the given UID
      --user USER_ID: only list packages belonging to the given user
      --match-libraries: include packages that declare static shared and SDK libraries

</code></pre>
<p>有很多参数，例如 <code>-f</code> <code>-a</code> <code>-e</code> <code>-s</code> <code>-3</code> 等，具体的参数含义可以自行查看，只在这里起一个抛砖引玉的作用。</p>
<p><code>-3</code>  查看第三方应用<br>
<img alt="在这里插入图片描述" loading="lazy" data-src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/direct/f347a9950aef43adabfe2da4c2d59ee4.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="2--获取app的启动activity">2.  获取app的启动activity</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>在做自动化测试时，经常需要启动应用，可以通过adb命令打开应用的启动activity，或者UI点击app的icon<br>
例如获取小米天气的启动activity</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-bash">adb shell pm dump-package com.miui.weather2
</code></pre>
<p><code>com.miui.weather2</code> 小米天气的包名，执行命令可以看到很多输出，我们需要重点过滤 <code>android.intent.action.MAIN:</code> 的下一行，来获取启动activity。以linux为例 执行以下命令</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">adb shell pm dump-package com.miui.weather2 | grep -A 2 -B 2 "android.intent.action.MAIN:"

</code></pre>
<p><img alt="在这里插入图片描述" loading="lazy" data-src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/direct/3381da2b4c9244a69cc4ef5b14e54f3a.png" class="lazyload"><br>
小米天气的启动activity就是 <code>com.miui.weather2/.ActivityWeatherMain</code>，打开activity的命令就是 <code>adb shell am start 启动activity</code><br>
<img alt="在这里插入图片描述" loading="lazy" data-src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/direct/e0a6b0ead0094637b34c0c4464c1e89a.png" class="lazyload"><br>
执行该命令就会在小米手机上打开天气，<code>am</code>命令将后续进行介绍</p>
<h2 id="3-清除应用数据">3. 清除应用数据</h2>
<p><code>adb shell pm clear packageName</code> 该操作不仅会清除app的全部数据，还会杀死app进程<br>
<img alt="在这里插入图片描述" loading="lazy" data-src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/direct/2511f3cb956e453ca514b3ca34dc91d8.png" class="lazyload"><br>
同样<code>pm clear</code>命令也有参数</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">clear [--user USER_ID] [--cache-only] PACKAGE
    Deletes data associated with a package. Options are:
    --user: specifies the user for which we need to clear data
    --cache-only: a flag which tells if we only need to clear cache data
</code></pre>
<p><code>--cache-only</code> 只清除缓存数据，不杀死进程<br>
<img alt="在这里插入图片描述" loading="lazy" data-src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/direct/17947ae7561d45158b1cd96668c59144.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="4-启用禁用应用组件">4. 启用/禁用应用/组件</h2>
<h3 id="41-安卓四大组件">4.1 安卓四大组件</h3>
<p>组件名称					| 	中文名				| 	主要作用				<br>
Activity						|	活动					| 	提供用户界面，与用户交互	<br>
Service					|	服务					| 	在后台执行长时间运行操作	<br>
Broadcast Receiver	|	广播接收器		| 	响应系统范围内的广播消息	<br>
Content Provider		|	内容提供器		|	管理应用数据的共享	<br>
四大组件的详细介绍，后续文章给出</p>
<h3 id="42-启用被禁用的应用组件">4.2 启用被禁用的应用/组件</h3>
<p><code>adb shell pm enable packageName/componentName</code> <code>packageName/componentName</code> 应用/组件</p>
<h3 id="43-禁用的应用组件">4.3 禁用的应用/组件</h3>
<p><code>adb shell pm disenable packageName/componentName</code> <code>packageName/componentName</code> 应用/组件</p>
<h2 id="5-隐藏展示应用icon">5. 隐藏/展示应用icon</h2>
<p><code>adb shell pm hide com.android.settings</code> 隐藏设置的icon 【icon 应用的启动图标】<br>
<code>adb shell pm unhide com.android.settings</code> 显示设置的icon<br>
<img alt="在这里插入图片描述" loading="lazy" data-src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/direct/10ad21f0736046d1860ab328c3d32fb7.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="6-授予应用权限">6. 授予应用权限</h2>
<p><code>adb shell pm grant perssionName</code> <code>perssionName</code>权限名称<br>
例如授予天气 发送通知的权限 <code>android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS</code><br>
<img alt="在这里插入图片描述" loading="lazy" data-src="https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/direct/a758158becec44b2bcf6dae81842a013.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>授予app权限时需要保证app unhide</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="61-如何查询app需要授予哪些权限">6.1 如何查询app需要授予哪些权限</h3>
<p><code>adb shell pm dump-package  packageName</code> 命令过滤出关键字 <code>permission</code><br>
例如 获取天气应用声明的权限</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">adb shell pm dump-package com.miui.weather2 | grep -i permission
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-bash">mi@mi-ThinkCentre-M760t:~$ adb shell pm dump-package com.miui.weather2 | grep -i permission
        1ddc1d3 com.miui.weather2/.backup.cloud.WeatherCloudBackupService filter 8ac0110 permission com.xiaomi.permission.CLOUD_MANAGER
        1ddc1d3 com.miui.weather2/.backup.cloud.WeatherCloudBackupService filter 8ac0110 permission com.xiaomi.permission.CLOUD_MANAGER
Permissions:
  Permission [com.miui.weather2.permission.MIPUSH_RECEIVE] (8f2e443):
    perm=PermissionInfo{58b4f95 com.miui.weather2.permission.MIPUSH_RECEIVE}
Permissions:
  Permission [com.miui.weather2.permission.WRITE_DB] (fc9cac0):
    perm=PermissionInfo{e295c9b com.miui.weather2.permission.WRITE_DB}
    installPermissionsFixed=false
    declared permissions:
      com.miui.weather2.permission.WRITE_DB: prot=signature
      com.miui.weather2.permission.MIPUSH_RECEIVE: prot=signature
    requested permissions:
      android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS
      android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
      miui.permission.USE_INTERNAL_GENERAL_API
      android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE
      android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USER_SELECTED
      android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED
      android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE
      android.permission.GET_TASKS
      android.permission.INTERNET
      com.miui.securitycenter.permission.SYSTEM_PERMISSION_DECLARE
      android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION
      com.xiaomi.mihomemanager.permission.receiveNormalBroadcast
      com.miui.weather2.permission.MIPUSH_RECEIVE
      android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES
      android.permission.CHANGE_WIFI_STATE
      android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
      android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM
      com.miui.weather2.permission.WRITE_DB
      android.permission.VIBRATE
      com.miui.securitycenter.permission.PERM_USE_INFO
      android.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE
      android.permission.QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES
      android.permission.WAKE_LOCK
      miui.permission.EXTRA_NETWORK
      android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION
    install permissions:
      android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE: granted=true
      android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED: granted=true
      android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE: granted=true
      android.permission.GET_TASKS: granted=true
      android.permission.INTERNET: granted=true
      com.xiaomi.mihomemanager.permission.receiveNormalBroadcast: granted=true
      com.miui.weather2.permission.MIPUSH_RECEIVE: granted=true
      android.permission.CHANGE_WIFI_STATE: granted=true
      android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE: granted=true
      com.miui.weather2.permission.WRITE_DB: granted=true
      android.permission.VIBRATE: granted=true
      com.miui.securitycenter.permission.PERM_USE_INFO: granted=true
      android.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE: granted=true
      android.permission.QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES: granted=true
      android.permission.WAKE_LOCK: granted=true
      runtime permissions:
        android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS: granted=true, flags=[ USER_SENSITIVE_WHEN_GRANTED|USER_SENSITIVE_WHEN_DENIED]
        android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION: granted=false, flags=[ USER_SENSITIVE_WHEN_GRANTED|USER_SENSITIVE_WHEN_DENIED]
        android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USER_SELECTED: granted=false, flags=[ USER_SENSITIVE_WHEN_GRANTED|USER_SENSITIVE_WHEN_DENIED]
        android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION: granted=false, flags=[ USER_SENSITIVE_WHEN_GRANTED|USER_SENSITIVE_WHEN_DENIED]
        android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES: granted=false, flags=[ USER_SENSITIVE_WHEN_GRANTED|USER_SENSITIVE_WHEN_DENIED]
        android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION: granted=false, flags=[ USER_SENSITIVE_WHEN_GRANTED|USER_SENSITIVE_WHEN_DENIED|RESTRICTION_UPGRADE_EXEMPT]
</code></pre>
<p>会发现有些权限上 <code>granted=false</code> ，对于这些权限就可以通过 <code>adb shell pm grant</code> 命令授予权限，授予完后 <code>granted=true</code></p>
<p>今天先介绍到这里，每天进步一点点！！</p>
